title: Deploy Configuration
description: Configuration for deploying a Supabase instance via Go agent

dashboard_username.description: Kong basic-auth username for Studio dashboard (optional, default: supabase)

dashboard_password.description: Kong basic-auth password for Studio dashboard (optional)

is_first_instance.description: Whether this is the first instance on the VM

enable_tls.description: Whether to provision Let's Encrypt TLS certificate

cert_pem.description: TLS certificate PEM for Postgres SSL (optional)

key_pem.description: TLS private key PEM for Postgres SSL (optional)

postgres_image.description: Postgres image ref (e.g. supabase/postgres:15.8.1.020). Used by agent to detect postgres uid/gid for SSL cert ownership.

compose_content.description: Pre-rendered docker-compose.yml from backend (optional, falls back to agent generation)

env_content.description: Pre-rendered .env file from backend (optional, falls back to agent generation)

kong_content.description: Pre-rendered kong.yml from backend (optional, falls back to agent generation)

services.description: Expected container-name suffixes to health-check. Each is prefixed with `{subdomain}-` (e.g. `acme-db`). v1.26.04 ships all 13 upstream services. Optional for legacy versions which fall back to the hardcoded triad [postgres, kong, studio].

postgres_container.description: Container-name suffix hosting postgres. Defaults to `postgres` (legacy 1.24.0 compose) and is `db` for upstream v1.26.04 compose.

init_sql_files.description: Map of filename -> content for docker-entrypoint-initdb.d scripts. v1.26.04 ships 7 upstream files. Empty for legacy versions (agent falls back to its bundled roles.sh).

volume_config_files.description: Map of relative path (under instance dir, e.g. `volumes/logs/vector.yml`) -> file content. Used for upstream compose bind-mounts that are not init SQL.

supabase_extras.description: Bundled secrets fetched from Vault (RS256 keys, logflare tokens, supavisor tenant id, etc.) for v1.26.04+. Substituted into compose/env by the backend; agent currently treats this as an opaque pass-through.
